summary: Cover missing flag, coverage, and status boundary cases. The change edits test files only in cmd/internal/flags, internal/coverage, and internal/mutator. Each TestSet row registers its flag as an ordinary and a persistent flag, each on a new command with reset Viper state, and reads the default and a changed value through the flag's configuration key. TestFeatureProfileIsCoveredLookup checks an absent file, a later matching block, no matching block, and a file with no block. TestFeatureStatusStringSkipped checks Skipped. New tests use the TestFeature prefix, because they add coverage of existing behavior. The flag test repairs remove existing lint findings, so make lint-shrink removes their entries from .lint/baseline.json. The baseline only shrinks. docs/development/test-assessment.md records the G03, G06, and G12 repairs. No production code, internal dependency, CLI flag, configuration key, JSON report field, or exit code changes.
trust_boundaries: The tests run locally and in existing CI. They start no network call and run no scanned source. The change keeps the development-check, delivery-finalization, and merge-queue-policy boundaries unchanged.
